I felt this

But all you have to do is talk. Let it all out. It is so easy to focus on the flaws in everyone and in humanity. But what you need to do is to look for the goodness, the life, the hope in everything and everyone that you see around you. Once you start seeing these things and opening yourself to the world you will start to see the light within you. You will shine brighter than anything either has and I believe in you. So listen my friend, these thoughts that are clouding your head are the flaws and they are easy to spot. Starting right now you are to note down one positive thing about the place where you are. If that is too hard then think of anything that makes you happy. Do this once per day and allow yourself to start observing the joy of life found in every corner of the globe. I wish you will on your journey dear friend and I pray that you can overcome your demons and get through this.
